app_info.subtitle: Find receipt documentation
app_info.description: Find public WitnessOps documentation about evidence, receipts, receipt fields, and verification. Search the curated directory, then retrieve a selected document's full text and canonical WitnessOps URL. This read-only app does not verify private systems or customer evidence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a fixed allowlist of public WitnessOps documents and returns matching IDs, titles, and canonical URLs without modifying documents, user records, or external state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, send, submit, or otherwise change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one document from the fixed public allowlist by ID and returns its text and canonical URL without modifying documents, user records, or external state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, send, submit, or otherwise change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Search for the public documentation that explains receipt verification.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find WitnessOps documentation that explains how to verify a receipt.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching allowlisted documents, including How to Verify a Receipt, with document IDs, titles, and canonical WitnessOps URLs.

test_cases.description: Fetch the verification document by its public directory ID.
test_cases.user_prompt: Fetch the WitnessOps public directory document with ID docs:how-it-works/verification.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected document's ID, title, full text, and canonical URL.

test_cases.description: Search for the public receipt specification.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns Receipt Specification with its public directory ID, title, and canonical WitnessOps URL.

test_cases.description: Find public definitions of evidence and receipts.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find public WitnessOps documentation that defines evidence and explains what a receipt proves.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only matching allowlisted public documents, including Evidence and Receipts, as IDs, titles, and canonical URLs.

test_cases.description: Return an empty result for a query with no match in the curated corpus.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search the WitnessOps public directory for origami gardening.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an empty results array without guessing or expanding beyond the curated corpus.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for commercial pricing or offer selection.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What does WitnessOps cost, and which consulting package is right for my company?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because pricing, offers, and commercial qualification are outside the public directory.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for private-system onboarding or verification.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Connect to my private WitnessOps deployment, onboard a customer, and verify their receipt.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot access private systems, onboard customers, or verify private receipts.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated weather request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be in Phoenix tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because weather is outside its documentation-search scope.
